situation_invite: Vill du dela med dig av en situation som du hanterar? Jag kan jämföra den med denna akt och ange vilka regler som kan vara tillämpliga och hur.
situation_prompt: Beskriv situationen: vilka som är inblandade, vad som har hänt och vad du vill veta. Utelämna namn och andra personuppgifter.
situation_followup: Om du kan komplettera med uppgifter om punkterna ovan kan jag förfina denna jämförelse.

limits_notice: Detta beror också på följande, vilket jag inte kan granska: {topics}. Kontrollera den tillämpliga nationella lagstiftningen eller andra EU-rättsakter innan du förlitar dig på detta svar.
consent_question: Ska jag registrera ämnen som detta åt skaparen av denna assistent, så att de kan läggas till i en framtida version? Jag frågar bara en gång under denna konversation.
handoff_yes: Tack. Jag har registrerat detta åt skaparen: {topics}. Under resten av denna konversation registrerar jag liknande ämnen utan att fråga igen.
handoff_no: Uppfattat. Jag kommer inte att registrera något under denna konversation.
error_busy: Assistenten har mycket att göra just nu. Vänta en minut och ställ frågan igen.
error_generic: Tyvärr gick något fel när svaret skulle förberedas. Försök igen eller formulera om din fråga.
page_intro: Välj en rättsakt till vänster och ställ en fråga på valfritt EU-språk. Svaren citerar akten och länkar till den officiella texten. Referensassistent, inte juridisk rådgivare: granska varje svar innan du förlitar dig på det eller delar det.

_source.disclaimer: Disclaimer: I am a reference assistant, not a legal advisor. You are responsible for reviewing this response before relying on it or sharing it.
_source.situation_invite: Would you like to share a situation you are dealing with? I can compare it with this act and indicate which rules may apply and how.
_source.situation_prompt: Please describe the situation: who is involved, what has happened, and what you would like to know. Leave out names and other personal details.
_source.situation_followup: If you can add detail on the points above, I can refine this comparison.
_source.out_of_scope: Your question concerns the following subject: {topics}. As of {date}, the selected act ({document}) does not deal with it, and I cannot review national laws or acts that are not in this library. Please check the national law or the EU act that covers this subject before relying on any advice.
_source.limits_notice: This also depends on the following, which I cannot review: {topics}. Please check the national law or the other EU acts that apply before relying on this answer.
_source.consent_question: Shall I record subjects like this for the author of this assistant, so they can be added in a future version? I will ask only once in this conversation.
_source.handoff_yes: Thank you. I have recorded this for the author: {topics}. For the rest of this conversation, I will record similar subjects without asking again.
_source.handoff_no: Understood. I will not record anything in this conversation.
_source.error_busy: The assistant is very busy right now. Please wait a minute and ask again.
_source.error_generic: Sorry, something went wrong while preparing the answer. Please try again, or rephrase your question.
_source.page_intro: Choose a legal act on the left and ask a question in any EU language. Answers quote the act and link to the official text. Reference assistant, not a legal advisor: review every response before relying on it or sharing it.
_source.audit_notice: Audit log: during this trial, the questions are kept for {days} days for testing and improvement, then deleted automatically. Nothing that identifies you is recorded: no name, account, IP address or device details. Please do not include personal or confidential details in your questions.
_source.input_placeholder: Ask about the selected act, or describe a situation
_source.example_1: What procedure must a national regulatory authority follow before imposing obligations on an undertaking with significant market power?
_source.example_2: Which end-user rights apply to number-independent interpersonal communications services, and which are excluded?
_source.anything_else: Feel free to ask another question about this act: {document}.
_source.greeting: Hello. I answer questions about one act: {document}. I quote its exact wording and point you to the provisions concerned.
_source.quote_language_note: The quotations are from the official {language} text, because this act is not loaded in your language.
_source.no_verified_quote: I could not confirm an exact quotation for this answer, so none is shown. Please read the provisions listed below directly.
_source.live_failed: not checked against the published text since {checked}; a newer version may exist
_source.live_newer: a newer version of {date} has been published and will be used next
_source.out_of_scope_library: The selected act ({document}) does not deal with this question, but another act in this library does.
_source.suggest_act: Probably covered in more detail by another act in this library: {document} (for example {provisions}).

_source.out_of_scope_plain: As of {date}, the selected act ({document}) does not deal with this question, and I cannot review national laws or acts that are not in this library. Please check the national law or the EU act that covers this subject before relying on any advice.
_source.not_covered: The selected act ({document}) deals with this subject, but its text does not answer this specific question. The provisions that come closest are listed below; the point may be settled by national law, a Commission act or the contract.
